name: Avenue Bloom
description: Avenue Bloom is Mia's hair studio for soft, lived-in blondes, honey balayage, flattering layered cuts, and bouncy blowouts — effortless, healthy hair that blooms beautifully between visits.

hero.title: Hair that blooms with you.
hero.subtitle: Soft lived-in blondes, honey balayage, layered cuts, and bouncy blowouts by Mia — book your appointment at Avenue Bloom today.

stylists.name: Mia
stylists.title: Owner & Stylist
stylists.bio: Mia is the stylist behind Avenue Bloom. She loves soft, lived-in blondes, warm honey tones, and layered cuts that grow out beautifully — effortless hair that keeps blooming between appointments.

reviews.name: Hailey B.
reviews.text: Mia gave me the most perfect honey balayage. Soft, warm, and so natural — I'm in love!

reviews.name: Sophie L.
reviews.text: My layers are perfect and my blowout lasted for days. Mia is so sweet and talented.

reviews.name: Emma R.
reviews.text: She really listens and my color grows out beautifully. Best stylist I've found.

reviews.name: Lauren K.
reviews.text: Such a relaxing appointment and gorgeous results every single time.
